message.content:
Methane has **four C–H covalent single bonds**. In the usual structural model, carbon shares one electron pair with each hydrogen, giving methane the formula **CH₄** and a **tetrahedral** shape with bond angles of about **109.5°**.[2][3][6]

If you meant a different aspect of “methane bond,” such as **bond strength**, **bond energy**, or **how methane interacts with other molecules**, I can explain that too.[1][3][5]
